recipes.name: Vanilla layer cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) milk, at room temperature
1 batch vanilla buttercream or chocolate frosting
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Mix in a third of the flour mix, then half the milk. Repeat, ending with flour. Mix until just combined.
Split the batter between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a wire rack.
Let cool for 1 hour before frosting.

recipes.name: Red velvet cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk the oil, buttermilk, eggs, food coloring, vanilla and vinegar in another bowl.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir until smooth.
Split the batter between the pans.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. For 24 cupcakes, bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a rack.
Let cool for 1 hour, then fill and frost with the cream cheese frosting.

recipes.name: Carrot cake
ingredients: 3 cups (300 g) finely grated carrots, about 5 carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Grate the carrots on the small holes of a box grater. Keep your fingers away from the blades.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in a big bowl.
Stir in the flour mix, then the carrots and walnuts.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then spread the frosting on top.

recipes.name: Lemon drizzle cake
ingredients: Drizzle: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar and 1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon juice
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan and line it with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the zest.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Stir the drizzle sugar and lemon juice together.
Poke holes all over the warm cake with a skewer and spoon the drizzle over it.
Let cool for 30 minutes in the pan. The drizzle sets into a crunchy crust.

recipes.name: Pound cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and flour a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes, until very light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack to cool.

recipes.name: Pineapple upside-down cake
ingredients: Topping: 1/4 cup (55 g) butter, melted, 1/2 cup (110 g) packed brown sugar
1/2 cup (120 ml) pineapple juice from the can
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pour the melted butter into a 9 inch round cake pan and sprinkle the brown sugar over it.
Lay the pineapple rings on top and put a cherry in each hole.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the pineapple juice.
Spread the batter over the pineapple.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Put a plate on top and flip the pan over with oven mitts. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Tres leches cake
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Topping: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) heavy cream whipped with 3 tablespoons sugar, plus cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the egg yolks with 3/4 cup of the sugar until pale, then stir in the milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then beat in the last 1/4 cup sugar until stiff.
Gently fold the whites into the batter and spread in the pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Let cool for 30 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, evaporated milk and cream.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork and slowly pour the milk mix over it.
Chill for 4 hours so it soaks in.
Spread the whipped cream on top and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Strawberry shortcake
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar for the berries
1/2 cup (115 g) cold butter, cut in cubes
3/4 cup (180 ml) cold heavy cream, plus a little for brushing
Whipped cream: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Stir the strawberries and 1/4 cup sugar and let sit for 20 minutes to get juicy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the flour, 3 tablespoons sugar, baking powder and salt.
Rub in the cold butter with your fingers until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the cream until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat it 3/4 inch thick and cut 8 rounds. Put them on a lined sheet and brush with cream.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Split the warm shortcakes, fill with strawberries and whipped cream.

recipes.name: Angel food cake
ingredients: 12 large egg whites (about 1 1/2 cups / 360 ml), at room temperature
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Sift the cake flour with 3/4 cup of the sugar twice.
Beat the egg whites, cream of tartar and salt in a very clean bowl until foamy.
Beat in the other 3/4 cup sugar a little at a time until stiff, glossy peaks form. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift the flour mix over the whites a quarter at a time, folding gently each time.
Spoon into an ungreased 10 inch tube pan and run a knife through to pop big bubbles.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until golden and springy.
Turn the pan upside down onto a bottle neck or its feet and let cool for 2 hours.
Run a knife around the edges to release the cake.

recipes.name: Funfetti sprinkle cake
ingredients: 1/2 cup (80 g) rainbow sprinkles, plus more on top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg whites and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mix and milk in turns, starting and ending with flour.
Gently fold in the sprinkles.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost and add more sprinkles.

recipes.name: Chocolate cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
Whisk in the egg, milk, oil and vanilla.
Carefully stir in the hot water. The batter will be thin.
Fill each liner 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour, then frost.

recipes.name: Lemon cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon zest
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 12-cup muffin pan with liners.
Rub the zest into the sugar with your fingers, then beat with the butter until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and lemon juice.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and pipe or spread on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 1/2 cups (300 g) powdered sugar, 3 tablespoons of the strawberry puree
steps: Blend the strawberries until smooth.
Simmer the puree in a small pot for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring, until it cooks down to about 1/2 cup. Let cool.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then the milk and 1/3 cup of the puree.
Fill the liners 2/3 full and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting ingredients until fluffy and spread on top.

recipes.name: Baked New York cheesecake
ingredients: Crust: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup (50 g) sugar, 6 tablespoons (85 g) butter, melted
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the crust ingredients and press into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan.
Bake the crust for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and flour on low until smooth.
Beat in the sour cream and vanilla.
Beat in the eggs one at a time on low, just until mixed. Too much beating makes cracks.
Pour over the crust.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, until the edges are set and the middle still jiggles a little.
Turn off the oven, crack the door and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour.
Chill for at least 6 hours before slicing.

recipes.name: Mini cheesecakes
ingredients: Fruit or pie filling to top
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 foil or paper liners and put a wafer in each.
Beat the cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Beat in the eggs on low, just until mixed.
Fill each liner 3/4 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the middles are almost set.
Let cool for 30 minutes, then chill for 2 hours.
Top with fruit before serving.

recipes.name: Texas chocolate sheet cake
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa, 6 tablespoons milk, 3 1/2 cups (420 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 cup (115 g) chopped pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a big bowl.
Heat the butter, water and cocoa in a pot until it boils. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the hot cocoa mix into the flour mix and stir.
Stir in the sour cream, eggs and vanilla.
Pour into the pan and bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
For the frosting, heat the butter, cocoa and milk until it bubbles, then take it off the heat.
Whisk in the powdered sugar and vanilla, then the pecans.
Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread. Let cool for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Black Forest cake
ingredients: 1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
Cream: 2 1/2 cups (600 ml) heavy cream, 1/3 cup (40 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 9 inch round pans and line with parchment paper.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Beat in the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla for 2 minutes.
Carefully stir in the boiling water. Ask an adult to help.
Pour into the pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 1 hour on a rack.
Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Put one cake on a plate, spread with cream, then spoon on half the cherry filling.
Add the second cake, cover the whole cake with cream, then top with the rest of the cherries and chocolate shavings.
Chill for 30 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) strong coffee or decaf, cooled
steps: Brew the coffee and let it cool. Decaf works and has less caffeine for kids.
Whip the cream until soft peaks form.
Beat the mascarpone, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the whipped cream.
Dip each ladyfinger in the coffee for 1 second and lay it in an 8 by 8 inch dish.
Spread half the cream over the ladyfingers.
Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the rest of the cream.
Cover and chill for 6 hours.
Dust with cocoa through a strainer before serving.

recipes.name: Victoria sponge
ingredients: 1/2 cup (160 g) strawberry or raspberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease two 8 inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Fold in the flour and baking powder, then the milk.
Split between the pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden and springy.
Let cool for 10 minutes in the pans, then 30 minutes on a rack.
Spread jam on one cake, then whipped cream, and put the other cake on top.
Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Swiss roll
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a 10 by 15 inch rimmed pan with greased parchment paper.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 5 minutes, until thick and pale. Beat in the vanilla.
Sift in the flour, baking powder and salt and fold gently.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until springy.
Dust a clean kitchen towel with powdered sugar and flip the hot cake onto it. Ask an adult to help.
Peel off the paper and roll the cake up in the towel from the short end.
Let cool rolled up for 1 hour.
Unroll, spread with jam and whipped cream, and roll it back up without the towel.

recipes.name: Gingerbread cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 9 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, spices and salt in another bowl.
Stir the flour mix into the molasses mix.
Carefully stir in the hot water until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Apple cake
ingredients: 2 medium apples, peeled and thinly sliced
Topping: 1 tablespoon sugar mixed with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round or square pan.
Peel, core and slice the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then the milk.
Spread the batter in the pan and press the apple slices into the top in circles.
Sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Orange olive oil cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 inch round pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
Whisk the eggs, sugar and zest for 2 minutes, until pale.
Whisk in the olive oil, milk and orange juice.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Pour into the pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 20 minutes, then dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Hot fudge pudding cake
ingredients: Topping: 1 cup (220 g) packed brown sugar and 1/4 cup (20 g) cocoa
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt in an ungreased 9 by 9 inch pan.
Stir in the milk, oil and vanilla, then spread it flat.
Sprinkle the brown sugar and cocoa topping evenly over the batter.
Carefully pour the hot water over the top. Do not stir. Ask an adult to help.
Bake for 40 minutes, until the top looks like cake. The sauce forms underneath.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then spoon into bowls with the sauce. Great with ice cream.

recipes.name: Cherry pineapple dump cake
ingredients: 1 can (20 oz / 567 g) crushed pineapple with its juice
1 can (21 oz / 595 g) cherry pie filling
1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) yellow cake mix, dry
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the pineapple and juice in a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Spoon the cherry pie filling over it.
Sprinkle the dry cake mix evenly on top. Do not stir.
Drizzle the melted butter all over the cake mix so most of it is wet.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until golden and bubbly.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.name: Basbousa
ingredients: Syrup: 1 cup (200 g) sugar, 3/4 cup (180 ml) water, 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Simmer the syrup ingredients for 10 minutes, then let cool. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease an 8 by 8 inch pan.
Mix the semolina, coconut, sugar and baking powder.
Stir in the yogurt, melted butter and milk. It will be thick.
Spread it in the pan, cut it into 16 diamonds or squares and press an almond into each.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake right away.
Let rest for 1 hour so it soaks in, then cut along the lines.

recipes.name: Coconut cake
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) canned coconut milk, stirred
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease a 9 by 13 inch pan.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the coconut milk.
Spread in the pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Spread the frosting on top and press the shredded coconut all over it.

recipes.name: Marble cake
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder mixed with 2 tablespoons milk
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Grease and line a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Spoon half the batter into another bowl and stir in the cocoa mix.
Drop spoonfuls of both batters into the pan, then swirl once with a knife.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 15 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

recipes.name: Pavlova
ingredients: 4 large egg whites, at room temperature
2 cups fresh berries and kiwi slices
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Draw an 8 inch circle on parchment paper and put it upside down on a baking sheet.
Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form.
Add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time while beating, until stiff and glossy.
Beat in the vinegar, cornstarch and vanilla.
Spread inside the circle, making the edges a little higher than the middle.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until crisp outside.
Turn off the oven and leave it inside with the door shut for 1 hour.
Just before serving, top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Cream puffs
ingredients: Filling: 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream, 2 tablespoons powdered sugar, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla
Powdered sugar or melted chocolate for the tops
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Bring the water, butter and salt to a boil in a pot. Ask an adult to help.
Dump in the flour and stir hard for 1 minute, until it forms a ball.
Take it off the heat and let cool for 5 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until the dough is smooth and glossy.
Drop 12 mounds onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven early or they collapse.
Poke a small hole in each and let cool for 30 minutes.
Whip the filling until stiff, cut the puffs in half and fill them.
Dust with powdered sugar or dip the tops in melted chocolate.

recipes.name: Churros
ingredients: Coating: 1/2 cup (100 g) sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
steps: An adult should do the frying. Hot oil is dangerous.
Bring the water, sugar, salt and 2 tablespoons oil to a boil in a pot.
Take it off the heat, add the flour and stir until it forms a smooth ball.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then spoon it into a piping bag with a big star tip.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a deep pot to 375°F (190°C).
Pipe 5 inch strips into the oil and cut them off with scissors.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Drain on paper towels for 1 minute, then roll in the cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Strawberry mochi
ingredients: 1/2 cup (140 g) sweet red bean paste
steps: Wrap each strawberry in about 1 tablespoon of red bean paste, leaving the tip showing.
Whisk the rice flour, sugar and water in a microwave-safe bowl until smooth.
Cover and microwave for 1 minute, then stir with a wet spatula.
Microwave for 1 minute more, stir, then 30 seconds more, until thick and see-through.
Dust the counter with cornstarch and tip the hot dough onto it. It is very hot, so let it cool for 5 minutes.
Cut into 8 pieces with a dusted knife.
Flatten each piece, wrap it around a strawberry and pinch it closed.
Eat the same day.

recipes.name: Strawberry poke cake
ingredients: 1 box (15.25 oz / 432 g) white cake mix, plus the eggs, oil and water on the box
8 oz (225 g) frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Make and bake the cake in a 9 by 13 inch pan following the box. Let cool for 20 minutes.
Poke holes all over the cake with a fork or the handle of a wooden spoon.
Stir the gelatin into the boiling water for 2 minutes, until dissolved. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cold water.
Slowly pour the gelatin over the cake so it fills the holes.
Chill for 3 hours.
Spread the whipped topping over the cake and add sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Chocolate icebox cake
ingredients: 1 package (9 oz / 255 g) thin chocolate wafer cookies
Chocolate shavings or berries to top
steps: Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Spread a little cream on a plate.
Spread a spoonful of cream on each wafer and stack them in a long log on its side on the plate.
Cover the whole log with the rest of the cream.
Chill for 6 hours. The wafers soften into cake.
Top with shavings or berries and cut slices at an angle.

recipes.name: Fruit pizza
ingredients: Topping: 8 oz (225 g) cream cheese, softened, 1/2 cup (60 g) powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla
3 cups sliced fruit like strawberries, kiwi, blueberries and mandarin oranges
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Press the dough into a 12 inch round pizza pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until light golden. Let cool for 45 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Spread it over the cookie crust.
Arrange the fruit on top in circles.
Cut into wedges with a pizza cutter.

recipes.name: Cookies and cream cupcakes
ingredients: Frosting: 1/2 cup (115 g) butter, 2 cups (240 g) powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons milk, 5 crushed cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a muffin pan with 12 liners and put a whole cookie in the bottom of each.
Crush 5 more cookies into crumbs for the frosting.
Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and salt in turns with the milk.
Fill the liners 2/3 full over the cookies.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 1 hour.
Beat the frosting butter, sugar and milk, stir in the crumbs, and frost.

recipes.name: Vanilla buttercream frosting
steps: Beat the butter for 2 minutes, until pale and creamy.
Add the powdered sugar 1 cup at a time on low speed.
Add the milk, vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 3 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Add more milk to make it softer or more sugar to make it stiffer. This frosts 24 cupcakes or a 2 layer cake.

recipes.name: Chocolate frosting
steps: Beat the butter until creamy.
Sift the powdered sugar and cocoa together so there are no lumps.
Add the sugar mix a little at a time with the milk, beating on low.
Add the vanilla and salt.
Beat on high for 2 minutes, until fluffy.

recipes.name: Cream cheese frosting
steps: Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add the powdered sugar a little at a time on low.
Beat in the vanilla and salt until fluffy. Do not overbeat or it gets runny.
Keep anything frosted with it in the fridge.

recipes.name: Whipped cream
steps: Chill the bowl and beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Pour in the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Beat on medium high for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft peaks form.
Stop as soon as it holds its shape. Too much beating turns it into butter.

recipes.name: Royal icing
steps: Use meringue powder instead of raw egg whites so it is safe to eat.
Beat the powdered sugar, meringue powder and 6 tablespoons water on low for 5 minutes, until glossy and stiff.
Add water a teaspoon at a time to thin it for flooding cookies.
Tint with gel coloring.
Keep it covered with a damp towel. It dries hard in about 6 hours.

recipes.name: Powdered sugar glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons milk or lemon juice
steps: Put the powdered sugar in a bowl.
Stir in the milk a little at a time with the vanilla until smooth and thick but pourable.
Drizzle over cakes, cinnamon rolls or cookies.
Let set for 15 minutes.
